passActionsUnavailable: The pass change could not be saved.
passActionsInvalidValidity: Choose an end date that keeps the required service dates.
passActionsRefundLimit: The refund exceeds the amount still available on the Nexi payment.
passActionsFirstUse: The pass has already been used or has a booking in progress.
passActionsPendingClaims: Wait for the outstanding Entry pack booking to settle, then try again.
passActionsPendingChange: An earlier pass change is still processing.
passActionsHolderUnavailable: The recipient’s account or Dotypos customer could not be resolved.
passActionsCapacity: The selected days do not have capacity for this pass.
passActionsSuccessorPresent: This pass already has a renewal. Changing its validity or holder would break the renewal.
passActionsChanged: The pass has changed. Refresh and try again.
passActionsGrantDescription: Grant a complimentary pass. The recipient gets an invitation to claim it.
passActionsReassignDescription: The new holder receives an invitation to claim the pass. The former holder loses access.
passActionsValidityDescription: Move the end date earlier or later.
passActionsUnlimitedValidityDescription: A later end reserves the added days. An earlier end releases the removed days.
passActionsPackCancelDescription: This stops new bookings and cancels future days booked with the pack.
passActionsUnlimitedCancelDescription: Future daily reservations are cancelled and released.
passActionsRecipientNameHint: Required when the recipient needs a new Dotypos customer record.
passActionsNexiNote: Send the refund in the Nexi back office.
passActionsNotify: Send cancellation emails for the affected bookings
passActionsPending: The change is queued. Refresh this page to check its status.
passActionsFailed: The change could not be completed.
passActionsNoRefund: No refund for a complimentary pass.
passActionsTransferConflict: Check the Dotypos bookings for {dates}. The transfer is paused.
passActionsAccessToday: Today’s access stays valid until it ends.
